description: This file defines the 'FileNode' class for representing file elements within a lexical editor. It includes methods for serialization, deserialization, DOM conversion, and rendering via React components, implementing ItemNodeInterface.

classes.name: FileNode
classes.description: A lexical node representing a file component with serialization, deserialization, DOM conversion, and React rendering capabilities.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string identifier of the node type.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a given FileNode.

methods.name: importJSON
methods.description: Constructs a FileNode instance from serialized JSON data.

methods.name: exportJSON
methods.description: Serializes the FileNode instance to JSON format.

methods.name: importDOM
methods.description: Provides rules for converting DOM elements into FileNode instances.

methods.name: exportDOM
methods.description: Generates DOM representation of the FileNode for rendering.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new FileNode with specified id, format, key, and zoom level.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the file node.

methods.name: getTextContent
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the node content, primarily for debugging or serialization.

methods.name: setZoomLevel
methods.description: Updates the zoom level of the file node.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Renders the React component associated with this node, passing relevant props such as class names, format, file ID, and zoom level.
